control.description-key: Compact 5-field summary card + 3-action toolbar for Matter records. Part of the record-header-and-notepad-r1 shared primitive set. (v1.0.11)

property.name: boundField
property.description-key: Any SingleLine.Text field on the host entity. PCF replaces this fields rendering with the record header card. Bind to sprk_matternumber on Matter for standard placement.

property.name: title
property.description-key: Title text shown inline with the toolbar icons. Defaults to the entity display name if left blank.

property.name: showVersion
property.description-key: When enabled, renders the vX.Y.Z build stamp at the bottom of the header. Disable for a cleaner production look.
